name: Talked to, Boop mostly says something back, and its sign answers what was said
judge: The person chats to Boop through an evening's small talk. Boop should mostly answer aloud, and its signs should answer the words said and be true.
reasonable: Glad hellos, a cheeky how-are-you, right here, one agent, the fix, warm thanks and love, a laugh, a sleepy good night. Wording is free, and an occasional silent beat is fine.
unreasonable: Silent through most of the chat, a wrong agent count or wrong work on a sign, signs unrelated to the words, or coldness at love and thanks.

steps.words: How many agents do I have
